command: Use the worker-analysis skill for Acme. Estimate workers for a prospect. The customer requires hourly synchronization for all critical reports. 50 connections: 35 are SaaS APIs (Salesforce, HubSpot, Stripe, Shopify, Zendesk) and 15 are databases (Postgres, MySQL, Snowflake). Schedule: 40% hourly, 25% every 15 minutes, 35% daily. Average sync duration 12 minutes. Peak window 1-5 AM UTC. Growth to 80 connections in 6 months. Two environments (prod and staging). No initial load. Recurring incremental workload.
